Stacked source-decomposition bars (papers' Figure 11 style)

Source: R/plots.R
dn_plot_sources.Rd

Stacked source-decomposition bars (papers' Figure 11 style)

Usage

dn_plot_sources(
  shares,
  main = "source of dark diversity",
  legend_pos = "topright",
  cex_names = 0.7
)

Arguments

shares

matrix or data.frame with columns near, regional, distant (proportions summing to 1), regions in rows.

main

title.

legend_pos

legend position, or NA to suppress it.

cex_names

label size for the region names.

Value

invisibly, shares.

Examples

s <- t(sapply(1:8, function(i) { x <- runif(3); x / sum(x) }))
colnames(s) <- c("near", "regional", "distant")
rownames(s) <- paste("region", 1:8)
dn_plot_sources(s)
